relations: The calm water surface mirrors the tree silhouette and starry sky, preserving vertical symmetry across the waterline.
If gentle ripples disturb the water, the tree's reflection will warp and stretch symmetrically around the base.
The tree remains a static silhouette on the ridge while the starry sky provides a continuous dark backdrop.
Atmospheric scattering or camera exposure changes may softly alter the sky's gradient without moving the tree or its reflection.
